notes.title: Dino Dash Party Major Updates!
notes.notes:
Dear Players. 

A few friends short of a full party? No worries! With our latest update of Dino Dash Party, we've added AI players to help fill in the gaps! 

Just add them in the character selection screen and enjoy maximum Dino Chaos! 

Thank you for choosing to play with us.|

Best regards,
Dino Dash Party Dev Team

notes.title: Dino Dash Party Monthly Updates!
notes.notes:
Dear valued players,

We are thrilled to announce the release of new exciting game modes! Get ready to experience some adrenaline-pumping action with Shoot the Hoop!, Time to Harvest!, Don't Get Swamped!, and Don't Touch Me!.

[olist]
[*]Knock The Puck!
[*]Shoot the Hoop!
[*]Time to Harvest! 
[*]Don't Get Swamped!
[*]Don't Touch Me! 
[*]Destroy Their Towers! 
[/olist]

These new game modes are designed to test your skills, improve your reflexes and provide you with hours of fun and entertainment. We are confident that you'll love them just as much as we do!

So what are you waiting for? Get ready to embark on an epic journey of thrill and excitement with our four new game modes. Don't forget to share your high scores and achievements with us!

Thank you for choosing to play with us.

Best regards,
Dino Dash Party Dev Team
